name: ac3forge
$comment: No "version" field: per vcpkg.json's own schema (learn.microsoft.com/vcpkg/reference/vcpkg-json), version is only required for a manifest describing a library/port - this one just declares this project's own build-time dependencies. The build's real version derives from git tags (cmake/GitVersionDerivation.cmake); the staged port's version-semver (packaging/vcpkg-port/ac3forge/vcpkg.json) is what tracks releases. See docs/releasing.md.
description: Clean-room AC-3 (ATSC A/52) encoder library and tools in C++23. Codec code has no third-party dependencies; vcpkg supplies test/tooling packages only.

profiling.description: Tracy profiler instrumentation (AC3FORGE_ENABLE_TRACY) - opt-in via -DVCPKG_MANIFEST_FEATURES=profiling, off by default so a normal build never pulls this in

adm.description: Boost header libraries needed by src/ac3adm's vendored libadm (AC3FORGE_BUILD_ADM) - opt-in via -DVCPKG_MANIFEST_FEATURES=adm, off by default so a normal build never pulls Boost in at all. This list is every boost/*.hpp libadm 0.14.0's own include/ and src/ actually #include, confirmed by grepping its vendored source rather than guessed from its README (which undersells it - it does not mention Rational or Integer at all, both needed by adm/utilities/time_conversion.hpp).

hearth.description: Hearth's dependencies (AC3FORGE_BUILD_HEARTH, planning/hearth-reference-player.md) - opt-in via -DVCPKG_MANIFEST_FEATURES=hearth, off by default so a library-only build pulls none of them. mbedTLS provides the PSA Crypto API behind src/sendspin's Noise and CPace; cpp-httplib carries its WebSocket transport, without the port's default brotli feature, and at 0.56.0 from the overlay port in cmake/vcpkg/ports; mjansson's mdns advertises and browses Sendspin's DNS-SD services; libFLAC and Opus encode and decode player@v1's FLAC and Opus streams.
